body:
Just started trying Dot. Meet Nova.

First question: what kind of computer does it have? Next up: exploring how it can work with my Mac Mini.

images.alt: Dot's onboarding screen titled 'Create your dot,' describing an always-on agent, complex work, proactive help, and data controls.

A conversation with Nova, a blue character with glasses. Nova describes the resources visible in its cloud sandbox, then discusses connecting a Mac Mini or cloning an accessible repository. The final question asks how to connect the Mac Mini.

final_approval: User confirmed publication of the displayed text and two images on 2026-09-30.
account_page_check: Latest visible post predates this attempt; no Dot post found.
